theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_weyl_ae_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < n → Integrable f → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Continuous (φ ε)) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ y : Euclid n, ε ≤ ‖y‖ → φ ε y = 0) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ y : Euclid n, |φ ε y| ≤ C / ε ^ n) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∫ y, φ ε y = 1) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid n)), Tendsto (fun ε => ∫ y, f y * φ ε (x - y)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (f x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
